Date Anchor & Cohort Logic

All monthly buckets in this dashboard are anchored on demo_booked_date — the date the lead booked a demo slot in Salesforce. This is a cohort view: "of all MQLs who booked a demo in month X, what eventually happened to them?"

This is different from gtm.full_funnel_details, which anchors each stage on the date that stage was reached. A lead that booked a demo in May but converted to SQL in June counts as a June SQL in full_funnel_details, but a May SQL in this dashboard. Both are correct — they answer different questions.
Recent months (especially the current month) will show lower SQL rates because many leads are still Open and haven't had time to resolve. SQL rates converge as months close out.

KPI Definitions

KPIDefinition
MQLsMarketing Qualified Leads. Opportunities with a confirmed demo booking date from a Marketing or Affiliates source. Count of distinct opportunities within the selected filters.
SQLsSales Qualified Leads. MQLs that advanced past the Profiling stage to SQL in Salesforce. Anchored to the original MQL demo_booked_date month, not the month SQL was reached.
SQL %SQLs ÷ Total MQLs. The share of booked demos that converted to a qualified sales opportunity.
Open MQLsMQLs still in an active stage (Profiling or similar) — neither SQL nor Lost. High Open counts in recent months are normal pipeline in progress.
Total Lost MQLsMQLs closed as Lost or Disqualified before reaching SQL. Includes no-shows and all other loss reasons.
Total Lost %Total Lost ÷ Total MQLs.
No Show Lost MQLsLost MQLs where the sub-reason is specifically "No Show" — the lead booked a demo, did not attend, and was subsequently marked lost.
No Show Lost %No Show Lost ÷ Total MQLs. Measures no-show risk across the full pipeline.
NS Share of LostNo Show Lost ÷ Total Lost. Of all MQL-stage losses, what share is attributable to no-shows specifically. Consistently 40–50% across months.

Booking Gap

The gap in days between demo_booked_date (when the lead confirmed their demo slot) and demo_scheduled_date (the actual date the demo is calendared for). This measures how far in advance the demo was booked.

BucketMeaningNS Rate
0 — Same DayDemo is scheduled for the same day as the booking. 37% of MQLs — the most urgent intent signal.—
1 — Next DayDemo slot confirmed the day after the form fill.13.9%
2-7 DaysDeliberate booker — took a few days to select a slot.16.2%
7+ DaysPlanned ahead. Lowest no-show rate among form-based leads.16.8%
No datedemo_happening_date_c or demo_booked_date is NULL — usually AE-created opps or returning contacts without a tracked booking event.—
Negative (DQ)Data quality flag: demo_booked_date is earlier than form_filled_date. Usually caused by manual date edits in Salesforce. Excluded from booking gap analysis.—

Demo Date Fields

FieldDefinitionCoverage
Demo Booked DateThe date the lead submitted a form and a demo slot was confirmed. Used as the month anchor for all metrics.100%
Demo Scheduled DateThe actual date/time the demo is calendared for (from Salesforce opportunity). May differ from Demo Booked Date if rescheduled.99.9%
Demo Delivered DateThe date the demo actually took place and was marked delivered in Salesforce.61% (only for delivered demos)

Filters

FilterDefinition
MonthDemo booked date month. Jul 2026 ★ is partial — data runs through the latest Salesforce sync date.
Source GroupMarketing (inbound digital) or Affiliates (partner-driven). Outbound and Strategic Partnerships are excluded from this dashboard.
SourceThe specific channel within the source group (Paid Search, Organic Search, Direct Traffic, Events, etc.).
RegionAPAC, EMEA, NAMER, Other — derived from opportunity region field.
ProductEOR (Employer of Record), AOR (Agent of Record), GP (Global Payroll), Unknown.
DeviceDevice type at form submission — Desktop, Mobile, Tablet, or Unknown.
Emp RangeCompany employee count range from enriched data.
Booking GapDays between form fill and demo booking (see above).
SDR OwnedAll — includes all MQLs. SDR Only — MQLs where the BDR owner is an SDR (Lima Dan, Bhish Makhija, Ashmitha Ganesh, Faizy Khanam). Non-SDR — all others.
Campaign (Paid Search)Google Ads campaign name. Only applies to Paid Search rows — other sources pass through unfiltered when campaigns are selected.

Clicking the Summary Table

Every number in the Monthly Breakdown table is clickable. Clicking a value opens the Detail View filtered to that specific cohort:

ClickDetail view shows
MQL countAll records for that month (full MQL cohort)
SQL / SQL %Only records where disposition = SQL
OpenOnly records still in Open / Profiling
Total Lost / Lost %Only records where disposition = Lost
No Show / NS% / NS of LostOnly no-show lost records

Click the same value again to deselect and return to full view.

Data Source & Freshness

Source table: gtm.mql_funnel_base_2 — rebuilt from gtm.full_funnel_details + Salesforce opportunity, lead, contact, campaign tables.

Includes: Marketing + Affiliates grouped sources only. Outbound and Strategic Partnerships are separate pipelines not reflected here.

Scope: Jan 2026 – Jul 2026. Previous years available in Salesforce but not yet in this dashboard.

Refresh cadence: Manual — base tables are rebuilt by running the DROP / CREATE TABLE AS SQL scripts. Salesforce source tables sync nightly.

MQL counts in this dashboard match gtm.full_funnel_details exactly for Jan–Jun. SQL counts differ slightly because of the date anchor difference described above — both are correct.
